title: Verified Poster Pipeline Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Fact-Verified Poster

Source Discovery

description: A vis-network chain of the nine steps of the verified poster route, with the user checkpoint and the single render step highlighted, a render-audit retry loop, per-step files and skip failures, and a sequence quiz that shuffles the steps.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

learningObjectives: The learner will sequence the nine steps of the verified poster route, and will explain which step is the mandatory human checkpoint and which step alone calls the image model.
prerequisites: Grid overlays and comparison posters from Chapter 10

accessibility.notes: Information panel is an aria-live region; the Skip a step menu is a native select; step names are text on every node

controls.label: Nine steps
controls.purpose: Show the description, the file written and what fails if skipped

controls.label: Arrows between steps
controls.purpose: Show what passes from one step to the next

controls.label: Skip a step
controls.purpose: Grey out one step and show the failure the guide anticipates

controls.label: Sequence quiz / Explore
controls.purpose: Shuffle the unnumbered steps to be clicked in order, then identify the checkpoint and the render step

controls.label: Show the answer
controls.purpose: Reveal what goes wrong if the selected step is skipped

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Process chain explorer with skip toggles and a shuffled ordering quiz
keyQuestions: Why must the user checkpoint come before the layout spec?
Which step alone calls the image model?
Why are steps 1 to 4 reusable without a poster?
commonMisconceptions: The render audit calls the image model itself
Verification can happen after the layout is drafted
The overlay is optional once a poster is verified
assessmentOpportunities: Out-of-order clicks in the sequence quiz
First-try identification of the checkpoint and render steps
